# Portrait / phone-frame sweep (B-042). Linux only. No audio required.
# Expect: each screen renders inside the phone frame with NO overflow reports.
emulate phone
shoot portrait_void_390
screen spectrum
shoot portrait_spectrum_390
screen dot
shoot portrait_dot_390
screen polo
shoot portrait_polo_390
screen void
overflows
# smaller and adversarial-narrow frames
emulate small
shoot portrait_void_360
emulate tiny
shoot portrait_void_280
overflows
# settings sheet in portrait
settings open
shoot portrait_settings_280
settings close
# back to full window
emulate off
shoot portrait_off
